objective: Preregister 12 candidates for T-20260929-10 (owner research-list item 3): long-only-ETP dual-VIX-signal volatility risk premium (Zarattini/Aziz/Mele 2025, SSRN 5316487, per the QuantConnect replication). 10 mechanism candidates (3 RV-window variants of the full 2-signal combo, signal-1-only, signal-2-only, each in SPY-remainder and SHY-remainder versions) plus 1 internal RAND placebo and 1 static 50/50 SMH/QQQ external control, for scripts/screen_batch.py --batch h20260929_10_vix_vrp_etp --iteration h20260929_10_vix_vrp_etp. No return, Sharpe or backtest number is computed in this dossier.

parameters.rule: Case1 (eVRP>0 & VIX<VIX3M): SVXY=VIX/100. Case2 (eVRP<0 & VIX<VIX3M): SVXY=0.5*VIX/100. Cases 3/4 (VIX>=VIX3M, any eVRP sign): SPY=1.0. eVRP=VIX-std(5d SPY returns,ddof=1)*sqrt(252)*100.

parameters.non_short_vol_leg: SHY (harness auto-remainder, candidate returns {} in cases 3/4)
parameters.rule: Same as VVRP_COMBO_RV5_SPY but cases 3/4 hold cash (SHY) instead of SPY.

Original QC-replicated parameters (10-day RV window). Closest faithful-parameter analog to the source's own 2016-01..2026-07 Sharpe 0.729 (SPY-remainder matches the source's own 'idle capital in SPY' convention, though on VIXY-vs-SVXY and cost/fill conventions that differ -- see report.md reconciliation).
Same as VVRP_COMBO_RV10_SPY but cases 3/4 hold cash (SHY) instead of SPY.
Same combo rule as VVRP_COMBO_RV10_SPY with a 20-day realized-vol window (upper end of QC's own 6-14 day grid, extended to test sensitivity beyond it).
Same as VVRP_COMBO_RV20_SPY but cases 3/4 hold cash (SHY) instead of SPY.
eVRP>0 -> SVXY=VIX/100 (full, no half-size); else SPY=1.0. Term structure (signal 2) dropped entirely -- isolates signal 1's own contribution.
Same as VVRP_SIG1ONLY_SPY but non-short-vol state holds cash (SHY) instead of SPY.
VIX<VIX3M -> SVXY=VIX/100 (full, no half-size); else SPY=1.0. eVRP (signal 1) dropped entirely -- isolates signal 2's own contribution.
Same as VVRP_SIG2ONLY_SPY but non-short-vol state holds cash (SHY) instead of SPY.

parameters.trigger_rate_calc: fraction of days in the full local history where VVRP_COMBO_RV10_SHY's real short-vol condition (case 1 or 2) fires; computed once, not restricted to select/anchor window.
parameters.rule: Deterministic pseudo-random day (SHA-256 hash of 'VVRP|RAND|<date>', uniform draw vs the calibrated trigger rate) substitutes for the real eVRP/term-structure condition; on a trigger day, holds SVXY at that day's VIX/100 weight (same sizing as the real candidates). Internal falsification control, never keep-eligible.
Fixed 50/50 SMH/QQQ, monthly rebalanced, no VIX signal at all. Owner-requested comparison point for this queue task; never keep-eligible, an external sanity benchmark only.

data.data_v1_sip_daily_plus_fred_vix_vix3m: SVXY/SPY/SHY/SMH/QQQ daily bars, data/sip/daily/*/*.parquet (local SIP archive, no new fetch); VIX and VIX3M daily closes, data/research/vix/VIXCLS.csv (already local, fetched 2026-09-28) and data/research/vix/VXVCLS.csv (newly fetched this iteration via FRED's public CSV export, the one new data source this round).

features.feature_v1_evrp_and_term_structure: eVRP_t = VIX_t - std(trailing N daily SPY close-to-close returns ending at t, ddof=1)*sqrt(252)*100 (N in {5,10,20}); term structure = VIX_t < VIX3M_t (contango) vs VIX_t > VIX3M_t (backwardation). Both read from data/research/vix/*.csv, aligned onto the trading-day index with at-most-1-day forward fill (documented FRED gap policy), truncated at asof -- no look-ahead.
features.feature_v2_none_static_control: No VIX signal at all -- STATIC5050_SMH_QQQ is a fixed monthly 50/50 SMH/QQQ blend, an external benchmark control only.

labels.label_v1_close_signal_next_open_fill: Signal at session close -> fill at next session's open, both entry and exit; frozen project contract. Realized vol uses only close-to-close returns (no same-day intraday return, unlike the QC replication's own intraday-implied addend).

validation.validation_v1_screen_lane_frozen_windows: screen_lane.py frozen select 2023-09-18..2025-12-31 / anchor 2024-01-08..2026-09-17 / holdout 2026-01-02..2026-09-17 (contaminated) / stress 2016-05-02..2023-09-15 windows, D freq (single version, no offset sweep) for all VVRP_*/RAND candidates; STATIC5050_SMH_QQQ is M freq (21-offset sweep, judged by median).

costs.cost_v1_10_20bps_next_open: 10bp per side primary, 20bp per side stress, screen_lane.py COST_BPS_PRIMARY/STRESS.

benchmarks.benchmark_v1_vvrp_vs_s3_k1_k2: K1 (median-offset -- n/a for D freq, single version -- net-10bp anchor Sharpe>=1.19 and stress Sharpe>=0.65, positive 20bp CAGR both windows) / K2 (63-session inverse-vol blend with S3 beats vol-matched S3+SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe both windows) / strong_keep (K2 edge>=0.10, or K1 Sharpe in both windows >= S3's own 1.49/0.81) / watch_recent (anchor Sharpe>=1.19, stress unmet), per this manifest's keep_rule. Only the 10 non-placebo/non-control candidates are keep-eligible.

trial_count_and_dsr_note: 12 candidates total (10 primary + 1 RAND placebo + 1 static-control) in this iteration's own screen_batch.py run; n_trials=12 is what leaderboard.json/results.json report automatically, and includes the 2 non-keep-eligible controls in that count (screen_lane.py's own convention, same as h20260929_01's 15=12+3). report.md additionally reports a manual 10-candidate-only DSR (excluding the 2 controls) using open_composer.research.campaign_statistics.deflated_sharpe_probability directly, for comparison.

keep_rule.K1: net-10bp Sharpe (D freq, single version -- no offset sweep) >= 1.1882 in the anchor window AND >= 0.6447 in the stress window, with positive CAGR at 20bp per side in both windows. Only the 10 primary (VVRP_*) candidates are eligible.
keep_rule.K2: a 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend of the candidate with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in BOTH the anchor and stress windows. Only the 10 primary candidates are eligible.
keep_rule.watch_recent: anchor-window Sharpe >= 1.1882 (K1's anchor bar) but the stress window does not clear its bar -- forward-tracked only, not a keep. Only primary candidates are eligible.
keep_rule.strong_keep: K2 edge >= 0.10 in both windows, or K1's Sharpe in both windows is >= S3's own (1.4853 anchor / 0.8059 stress, exact figures from h20260928_01_s3_rebalance_tranching/results.json).
keep_rule.pass_requires: K1 OR K2, for a primary (VVRP_*) candidate only.
keep_rule.placebo_and_benchmark_internal_falsifica: If a primary candidate would otherwise be kept (K1, K2, strong_keep, or watch_recent), but VVRP_RAND_PLACEBO or STATIC5050_SMH_QQQ has a judged anchor-window Sharpe >= that primary candidate's own judged anchor Sharpe, the primary candidate is demoted to 'not kept (placebo/benchmark replication)'. VVRP_RAND_PLACEBO and STATIC5050_SMH_QQQ themselves are NEVER eligible for K1/K2/strong_keep/watch_recent regardless of their own Sharpe.
keep_rule.multiple_comparisons: This iteration's own leaderboard.json/results.json report n_trials=12 (10 primary + 1 placebo + 1 static control), computed automatically by scripts/screen_batch.py. A manual 10-candidate-only DSR is additionally computed and reported in report.md for comparison.
